_comment: RECOMMENDED EXAMPLE model manifest for the paid app (W5-5, E-8). The exact list + revision pins are the open model-strategy decision (docs/HANDOFF-MICKAEL.md §2). 'bundled' = ship in installer / fetch on first run (works offline). 'on_demand' = download with consent on first use. Every 'revision' is a 40-hex commit SHA (pinned 2026-10-30 from the Hub; the two the Studio runs, whisper-turbo and qwen-35b-4bit, match its cached copies). To move a pin: read the new SHA from the model page, test it, change it here (codec_setup reads the pin from there). Models install to ~/.codec/models/<name>/ (never inside the .app).
